Connect the stars in a single stroke to complete each constellation.

How to play
1. Tap a star to start. 2. Slide your finger — or tap a neighbouring star — to draw the line.
· Made a mistake? Use "Undo" to step back, or "Restart" to begin again.
· Up to 3 hints per stage — a hint shows you the next move.
· There is no timer, so take your time. You can stop midway and pick up right where you left off.
